exposure_or_intervention: Structured counselling addressing the early protection gap
main_finding: Structured counselling improved uptake, with a larger effect when the early protection gap was addressed.
relevance_reason: It directly compares the same intervention mechanism and outcome as R1.

usable_claims.claim: Prior prospective evidence links structured counselling with higher treatment uptake.
Explicitly addressing the early protection gap may strengthen the counselling effect.

forbidden_inferences: The study proves that counselling caused higher uptake.
The reported effect applies to every clinical setting.
